Ana (CISO): Quick security bulletin: three required actions this month to tighten access and mitigate token sprawl. Please read and ack.
Ana (CISO): Actions: 1) Org-wide MFA enforcement for interactive accounts (SSO + 2FA) by 2026-04-20. 2) Immediate audit of deploy keys and service tokens older than 60 days; rotate or replace with short-lived creds. 3) Privileged role review: confirm members for admin/editor roles by 2026-04-15.
Marco (VP Eng): Will team leads get a CSV of users in privileged roles?
Ana (CISO): Yes, we'll publish per-team CSVs in the secure S3 bucket and email leads. Report will include principal, role, last_active, and owner.
Tess K: Where's the token audit tool? Can we run it locally?
Ana (CISO): Use the internal audit endpoint or the lightweight scanner from the infra repo. Example run: 
```
# list service tokens >60 days
./token-audit --org redwood --age 60 --format csv > stale_tokens.csv
```
DevOps Bot: notice: scheduled job token-audit-runner will run a dry-check 2026-04-09T02:00:00Z and post results to #eng-security.
Ravi P: If we replace deploy keys with short-lived creds, any recommended pattern for GitHub Actions?
Ana (CISO): Use OIDC with short-lived tokens + repo-scoped roles. We added example workflows to the docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/security/oidc-actions-example.
Marco (VP Eng): Exceptions? Some external vendor integrations use long-lived keys and can't rotate quickly.
Ana (CISO): Exceptions allowed but limited: open a ticket to security-exceptions with SLA for rotation and compensating controls. Default exception window is 21 days; longer requires CISO approval.
Tess K: Does this affect service accounts created by CI pipelines?
Ana (CISO): Yes. CI-created service accounts must adopt short-lived credentials by 2026-05-01 or request exception. We'll provide helper lib to mint ephemeral creds.
DevOps Bot: reminder queued: 2026-04-13 09:00 UTC 4-day follow-up to leads that haven't acknowledged.
Ravi P: Thanks, can we get the CSV early? I'll start tagging owners.
Ana (CISO): CSVs will be uploaded by EOD 2026-04-08. Please escalate blockers here. Ack required from all team leads.
